## Xeniomorph Shadow (CR 11)

The xeniomorph appears to be an empty suit of armor set up for display. Suddenly, the “armor” ripples and shifts, revealing a mouth full of sharp teeth in its torso along with multiple orange eyes. Its form seems to waver between solid and shadow as it moves with uncanny grace.  

**XP** 12,800  
Xeniomorph shadow 12  
N Medium aberration (shapechanger)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., blindsense 30 ft. (in dim light or darkness); Perception +20  


**Defense**


**AC** 25, touch 19, flat-footed 19 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural armor, +3 deflection)  
**hp** 132 (12d8+36)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +13, **Will** +11  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, improved uncanny dodge, reactive defense  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +13 (1d6+5), tongue +12 (special)  
**Special Attacks** counterattack, misdirection, predator’s maw, redirect attack, sticky tongue  
**Special Abilities** mimic object, shadow step, shadowcraft  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 20, **Con** 16, **Int** 16, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +14, **CMD** 30  
**Feats** Adaptive Camouflage, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Mimetic Mastery, Prehensile Tongue Mastery, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +20, Bluff +15, Climb +18, Disguise +25, Escape Artist +20, Perception +20, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +32, Survival +17  
**Languages** Undercommon, Silent Speech (Xeniomorph), Abyssal, Common, Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**


**Ghost Step (Ex)** The xeniomorph gains +6 bonus on Stealth checks.  

**Mimic Object (Ex)** As a standard action, can assume the shape of any Medium object, gaining a +20 racial bonus on Disguise checks to do so.  

**Misdirection (Ex)** The xeniomorph can use Bluff to feint in combat as a move action. On success, target is denied Dexterity bonus to AC against the next attack made by an ally before the end of the Xeniomorph’s next turn.  

**Morphic Insight** Once per day, the xeniomorph can gain a +2 insight bonus on a single Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check related to understanding or interacting with an object they’ve successfully mimicked.  

**Predator’s Maw (Ex)** The xeniomorph’s bite attack deals 1d8+3 damage. Once per day, it can increase damage to 1d10+3 and gain +2 on attack roll, plus 1 point of bleed damage.  

**Redirect Attack (Ex)** When missed by a melee attack, the xeniomorph can attempt to redirect that attack to another creature adjacent to both the Xeniomorph and the attacker. The attacker must make a new attack roll against the new target. Usable 2/day.  

Shadow Powers
